result.title: WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation
result.summary: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向从设计规格生成可交互多页网站的任务，提出反向合成流程 WebVibe：先在浏览器中验证跨页与页内交互，再由回放确认的状态反推多模态输入以构建语料，并用基于回放轨迹和状态转移拼图的权重共享自教师提供 token 级监督（Interactive-SDPO）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先验证交互再生成监督信号」与「用回放轨迹替代标量奖励做稠密 token 级监督」的思路，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、监督噪声过滤与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是网站代码生成，与视觉推理状态本身关联较远。
